title: Symmetry-Compatible Principle for Optimizer Design: Embeddings, LM Heads, SwiGLU MLPs, and MoE Routers
abstract: arXiv:2605.18106v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A striking geometric disparity has long persisted in the practice of deep learning. While modern neural network architectures naturally exhibit rich symmetry and equivariance properties, popular optimizers such as Adam and its variants operate inherently coordinate-wise, rendering them unable to respect the equivariance structures of the parameter space. We address this disparity by introducing a symmetry-compatible principle for optimizer design: the gradient update rule should be equivariant under the symmetry group acting on the corresponding weight block. Following this principle, we first provide a unified perspective on bi-orthogonally equivariant updates for general matrix layers, as employed by stochastic spectral descent, Muon, Scion, and polar gradient methods. translated_title: 优化器设计的对称兼容原则：嵌入层、语言模型输出头、SwiGLU多层感知机与混合专家路由器
translated_abstract: 摘要：深度学习实践中长期存在一个显著的几何差异。尽管现代神经网络架构天然展现出丰富的对称性与等变性，但Adam及其变体等流行的优化器在本质上是逐坐标操作的，因而无法尊重参数空间的等变性结构。我们通过为优化器设计引入一个对称兼容原则来解决这一差异：梯度更新规则应当在作用于相应权重块的对称群下保持等变。遵循这一原则，我们首先为一般矩阵层的双正交等变更新提供了统一视角，这正是随机谱下降、Muon、Scion和极梯度方法所采用的方式。更重要的是，通过从正交群拓展到置换对称与共享平移对称，我们为具有相应对称性的参数块推导出了对称兼容的优化器……
tldr: 该论文提出优化器设计的对称兼容原则——梯度更新规则应在权重块的对称群下保持等变，据此统一了双正交等变更新方法，并为嵌入层、语言模型输出头、SwiGLU MLP和MoE路由器等结构推导出对称兼容的优化器。
